raw:
I fixed B1 in three commits on feature/US-02-02 (not pushed). The local acceptance run on head ed010fd passes all 30 Maestro flows, but two pixel-colour checks fail on this emulator. One of them is the new check spec N4 asked for. Main fails the same check on this emulator in the same way.

**B1.** "Kontynuuj" and the category name are now two separate Text lines (testIDs `continue` and `continue-category`). Each is sized with `cardType()` for the window width (DEC-53). `numberOfLines` and `adjustsFontSizeToFit` are gone. The TC-02-06/07/08 flows now assert `continue-category` is visible with the category text, below `continue`. I checked the step-02 screenshots of TC-02-06 and TC-02-08: they show "Kontynuuj" and then "4+" / "3+" on its own line, white on black. Because the continue entry now also shows "3+" / "4+", I changed the cards tests to press the list entry by its testID instead of by text.

**The colour-check failures.** On this run, AC-02-01-4 step 4 (first-launch screen) and my new TC-02-08 step 2 check (screen with the continue entry) both fail on 1/255-off rows at the edges of the category entries' borders. No flagged row is in the continue entry itself.
- I ran main (c3df55e) on the same emulator from a temporary worktree, since removed. It fails AC-02-01-4 step 4 identically: rows 970, 1326 and 1332.
- The emulator was rebooted at 13:03. Every local run before that passed this check; the earlier failing run on 23248061 was already on the new boot.
- CI acceptance.yml passed on 23248061.

So this looks like this emulator's rendering, not the code. Because CI takes the worst result for an id, the new check is named after TC-02-08: if CI showed the same artifact, TC-02-08 would count as failed.
